claim: Legoland Windsor 2026 marks its 30th birthday and debuts Minifigure Speedway (world's first LEGO duelling rollercoaster, forward and backward) plus LEGO City Driving School; events include LEGO NINJAGO Celebration (Mar 28–Apr 12), LEGO Festival (Jul 20–Aug 31), Brick or Treat (Oct) and Christmas Bricktacular.
quote: Minifigure Speedway... Put the pedal to the metal and then slam it in reverse, who will be first across the finish line?... LEGO City Driving School... Earn your first driving licence at LEGO City Driving School!

claim: Legoland Windsor 2026 uses dynamic pricing; off-peak day tickets can be as low as £32 (Mar–Oct), and annual passes start at £64 per person.
quote: Savings are based on purchasing a £32 ticket available on off peak days (March - October)... Annual Passes start at just £64 per person.

claim: Bray sits roughly 3.2 miles (~5 km) from Legoland Windsor Resort, making it the closest major theme park to the village.
quote: Bray is 3.2 miles from LEGOLAND Windsor Resort.

claim: Bekonscot Model Village (Beaconsfield, ~25 km from Bray) charges £15.00 adult / £9.50 child for 2026, with 10% off when booked at least 48 hours ahead online; it bills itself as the world's oldest original model village (1929) depicting 1930s rural England across 1.5 acres.
quote: Adults: £15.00, Children: £9.50... 10% off the standard entry price when booked at least 48 hours in advance... the world's oldest original model village and railway

claim: Beale Wildlife Park (Pangbourne, ~28 km west of Bray) charges £17.50 adult / £15.50 child / £16.50 senior in advance, with +£2 on-the-day surcharge; under 2s free.
quote: Adults: £17.50, Children: £15.50, Seniors: £16.50... all tickets are +£2.00 if bought on the day of visiting.

claim: Odds Farm Park (near High Wycombe, ~18 km from Bray) combines rare-breed farm animals, outdoor sand/water/mini-golf play and a giant indoor soft-play barn, open daily year-round with seasonal dinosaur weekends and adult farm nights.
quote: Whatever the Season and whatever the weather... rare breed animals with daily interactive activities... dinosaur weekends, adult farm nights, and seasonal celebrations

claim: Odds Farm Park standard pricing runs roughly £13.50 adult, £12.50 child (2-16), £4.95 toddler (1-2), under-1s free; site is cashless and pre-booking required.
quote: children aged 1-2 requiring a nominal £4.95 ticket, and children under 1 visiting free of charge... standard tickets for children aged 2-16 are £12.50 and standard tickets for adults are £13.50

claim: The Look Out Discovery Centre (Bracknell, ~22 km from Bray) charges adults £5.55–£11.10, children £4.10–£8.20 and family savers £15.20–£30.40 depending on date; under-3s and carers are free.
quote: Adult: £5.55 to £11.10, Child: £4.10 to £8.20, Saver Family Ticket: £15.20 to £30.40... free admission for children under 3 and carers

claim: The Look Out runs 90+ hands-on science exhibits inside Swinley Forest woodland and requires pre-booked timed sessions; the lift is currently out of service.
quote: over 90 hands-on science activities which children of all ages can enjoy... The lift in the discovery centre exhibition is currently out of service

claim: Thames Valley Adventure Playground in Taplow (3 km from Bray) is a 2.5-acre inclusive play charity for children and adults with disabilities, featuring sensory room, soft play, crazy golf, zip wires and adapted bikes; suggested contribution £14/session or £20 all day, carers free.
quote: 2.5 acres of inclusive play facilities including a multi-sensory room, giant soft play, crazy golf, castle climbing and specially adapted bikes... The suggested contribution is £14 per user for a single session, and £20 for an all day session

claim: Coral Reef Waterworld in Bracknell (~22 km) is the local water park with flumes and wave features; published prices are £18.60 adult, £13.20 child, £1.20 under-5s and spectators, with 5 hours of free parking on registration plate.
quote: £13.20 for kids, £18.60 for adults (16+), £1.20 for under 5s, £1.20 for spectators... 5 hours of free parking when they provide their vehicle registration

claim: California Country Park near Wokingham (~25 km from Bray) offers free entry to 100 acres of heath and bog, with adventure playground, sensory garden, zip wire, paddling pool, fishing on Longmoor Lake and Jacksons Cafe.
quote: Play area including water play, tree houses, woodland adventure trail, Sensory Garden... zip wire course is absolutely unmissable... Fishing at Longmoor Lake

claim: Dinton Pastures (Wokingham, ~25 km) is a 350-acre free-entry country park with adventure playground, adventure golf, disc golf, sailing, paddlesports and pond-dipping aimed at ages 2–adult through its Activity Centre.
quote: 350-acre country park... award-winning adventure play area... sailing to bushcraft and paddlesport to pond dipping, catering for a range of ages from two year olds to adults

claim: Golden Tours hop-on hop-off open-top bus tour of Windsor and Eton runs March–November with 11 stops and a 24-hour ticket priced from £16 adult, £9 child (5-15), £13 senior/student, £40 family (2+2).
quote: 24-hour ticket prices are from; Adult £16.00, Child (5-15) £9.00, Senior/Student £13.00, Family (2+2) £40.00... Hop-on, hop-off tours of Windsor operate March to November

claim: Adventure Play at Windsor Great Park (the woodland playground next to The Savill Garden, ~8 km from Bray) sells 2-hour timed sessions at off-peak £10 adult / £13 child and peak £12 adult / £16 child; under-2s free, free car park.
quote: Off-peak prices are £10 for adults and £13 for children, while peak prices are £12 for adults and £16 for children, with under 2s free

claim: ZSL Whipsnade Zoo sits 38 driving miles (~61 km) from Windsor and so falls well outside the 30 km Bray radius — exclude from a Bray weekend shortlist.
quote: The driving distance between Whipsnade Zoo and Windsor is 38 miles, and it takes approximately 49 minutes to drive.
